name: Choice Juicery
notes: Own Squarespace site, /entire-menu page, plain server-rendered HTML, no JS needed. A multi-location chain (Carlsbad Village Dr location matches the work-list address); menu is shared across locations per the site's own nav. Smoothies each list two sizes (cup emoji = smoothie, bowl emoji = smoothie bowl with granola + fruit); both filed as separate rows. 'Secret Menu' nav link exists but its items were not on this page and were not fetched (out of scope, adjunct).
